title: UniCompress: From Multi-LoRA Experts to One Compact Model for Edge Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.06075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Embodied and edge systems increasingly rely on vision-language models (VLMs) to support heterogeneous skills, yet deploying a separate task adapter for each skill while retaining a high-precision backbone creates substantial memory and management costs. We present UniCompress, a deployment-oriented framework that converts multi-task expertise into one compact, adapter-free model. Starting from a consolidated BF16 Qwen3-VL-4B teacher, UniCompress constructs an asymmetric INT2 student using GPTQ initialization and teacher-guided quantization recovery. The approach jointly quantizes and recovers the projection weights in the vision encoder and language backbone, enabling aggressive compression of the complete vision-language model while preserving its multi-task behavior. translated_title: UniCompress：从多LoRA专家到面向边缘智能的单一紧凑模型
translated_abstract: 具身智能与边缘系统日益依赖视觉语言模型（VLM）来支持多样化的技能，然而为每个技能部署独立的任务适配器、同时保留高精度骨干网络，会带来巨大的内存和管理成本。我们提出了UniCompress，一个面向部署的框架，它将多任务专长转化为一个紧凑的、无适配器的单一模型。以整合后的BF16 Qwen3-VL-4B教师模型为起点，UniCompress利用GPTQ初始化和教师引导的量化恢复，构建了一个非对称的INT2学生模型。该方法对视觉编码器和语言骨干网络中的投影权重进行联合量化与恢复，在保留多任务行为的同时，实现对完整视觉语言模型的激进压缩。我们在四个异构的具身任务上评估了UniCompress：姿态识别、家庭安全理解、多模态对话路由以及移动GUI动作预测。
tldr: UniCompress提出将多个多任务LoRA专家蒸馏整合为一个无适配器的INT2紧凑模型，通过GPTQ初始化和教师引导的量化恢复，在极低内存占用下保留完整视觉语言模型的多任务能力，适合边缘智能部署。
en_tdlr: UniCompress converts multi-task LoRA expertise into a single compact adapter-free INT2 model through GPTQ initialization and teacher-guided quantization recovery, preserving multi-task VLM capabilities at extreme compression for edge intelligence deployment.
